fusions.name: Springing Snatch
fusions.desc: Bolts to the target from up to 7 tiles away and grabs it, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hind-Foot Lob
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 7 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Bolt Hole
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward. For 3 seconds after, you move 30% faster.

fusions.name: Never Still
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 15%.
